annotations.title: Calculate late payment interest on an invoice

description: Calculate the statutory interest (Bank of England base rate plus 8%) and fixed compensation a business can claim on a late-paid commercial invoice under the Late Payment of Commercial Debts Act, from the amount, the due date and the payment date.

amount.description: Unpaid invoice amount, VAT included if charged

dueDate.description: The last day payment was due

paidOn.description: The day it was paid; defaults to today

name: calculate_late_payment_interest
title: Calculate late payment interest on an invoice
